question: What materials are named as suitable for the vessels addressed to the goddess?
premises: Vessels may be made of clay
Vessels may be made of bell-metal or copper-metal
inference: Suitable vessels include those made of clay, tortoise-derived material, bell-metal, and copper-metal.
plain_english: O Goddess, they may be made of clay, born of a tortoise, made of bell-metal, or made of copper.
